entities.name: David Zubik

entities.summary: David Allen Zubik is a retired American Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Pittsburgh from 2007 to 2025. He previously served as Bishop of Green Bay from 2003 to 2007, and as Auxiliary Bishop of Pittsburgh from 1997 to 2003.
